decisions.reason: The dumper was only mentioned in passing and resembles the heavy-vehicle line the firm already abandoned, so it is a weak option, but without evidence of failure and with little cost to keep a listed item, it stays open for now.

The inclined furniture lift had its own page and belongs to a coherent lift family whose shared technology keeps holding costs low, so keeping the option open is cheap while its value is still unresolved.
The building material lift shares its platform with the furniture lifts and serves an established craft and construction market, so it is a low-cost option that is worth retaining.
The truck-mounted variant needs somewhat more investment, but it complements the lift line and has shown no sign of failure, so abandoning it is not yet justified.
